response.sql: WITH track_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / CAST(Milliseconds AS DECIMAL) AS bytes_per_ms, UnitPrice FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0), album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(bytes_per_ms) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price FROM track_rates GROUP BY AlbumId), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg_bytes_per_ms FROM track_rates) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.avg_bytes_per_ms, a.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms AS difference FROM album_stats a CROSS JOIN overall_avg o ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
